s.zh: 在右侧警报栏提示：巨魔尸体将会复活、蝌蚪化形中、巫妖复生中、命匣不在殖民地、脑髓不足。点警报会跳到对应目标。
s.en: Shows in the alerts on the right: troll corpses will revive, tadpole transformation in progress, lich reviving, phylactery not in the colony, low brain matter. Clicking an alert jumps to the target.

s.zh: 这些巨魔的尸体还在再生，到时会原地站起来（敌方巨魔也一样）：
s.en: These trolls' corpses are still regenerating and will stand up where they are (enemy trolls too):

s.zh: 用火烧掉或火化才能彻底杀死。选中尸体可以点“标记焚烧”，让搬运工优先送到火葬场。
s.en: Burn them with fire or cremate them to kill them for good. Select a corpse and click "mark for burning" to have haulers take it to a crematorium first.

s.zh: 这些人脑中有夺心魔蝌蚪，化形完成后会变成夺心魔：
s.en: These people have mind flayer tadpoles in their brains and will become mind flayers once the transformation completes:

s.zh: 阻止办法：做“取出蝌蚪”手术；或服用抑灵剂冻结进度（成为半夺心魔，要一直服药）。
s.en: To stop it: perform "remove tadpole" surgery, or take a suppressant to freeze progress (becoming a half-illithid who must keep taking it).

s.zh: 这些巫妖已经死去，灵魂在命匣里等待复生：
s.en: These liches have died, and their souls wait in the phylactery to revive:

s.zh: 命匣被毁就再也不能复生；保护好它。
s.en: If the phylactery is destroyed, they can never revive; protect it.

s.zh: 复生已就绪，等命匣旁边有空位
s.en: Revival ready, waiting for a free spot next to the phylactery

s.zh: 本方巫妖的命匣不在殖民地的家园区里：
s.en: Your liches' phylacteries aren't in the colony's home area:

s.zh: 巫妖死后只能在命匣旁边复生；命匣落到别人手里或被毁，巫妖就回不来了。
s.en: Liches can only revive next to their phylactery; if it falls into others' hands or is destroyed, the lich can't come back.

s.zh: 这些夺心魔的脑髓低于
s.en: These mind flayers' brain matter is below

s.zh: 吞噬大脑（囚犯、尸体）或脑浆罐可以补充；脑髓耗尽会饥饿发狂。
s.en: Devouring brains (prisoners, corpses) or brain jars refill it; when it runs out they go mad with hunger.
